headline: Executive order signed April 8, 2025, aimed at supporting the US coal industry and changing an earlier executive order.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs federal action to support the American coal industry. It also changes an earlier order, Executive Order 14241. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps, rules, or programs in the order are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at supporting their industry, though the specific measures are not described in the available material.
They work in the industry the order seeks to support, but any direct effects on jobs or pay are not stated in the available material.
